in_hebrew.name: Hofstetter
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hofstetter הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German words ‘hof’ (house) and ‘setter’ (setter), this name refers to someone who builds or establishes a new home. In a metaphorical sense, it could also signify a spiritual foundation or a strong sense of belonging.
